name: brain
description: Amnesia Labs internal alpha. Invite only.
changelog: v0.10.3 — the research skill no longer assumes the host can run subagents. Many self-hosted setups serve one model request at a time or have no Agent tool, and the skill's large-gap path told the model to spawn 5-8 parallel research agents regardless. It now picks an execution mode per host: parallel only when an Agent/Task tool is actually available, sequential when agents exist but the model server handles one request at a time, and inline (the model researches each facet itself with WebSearch/WebFetch) when there are no agents. Rounds, storage and citations are the same in every mode, and a failing mode drops to the next instead of abandoning the research. Prior: v0.10.2 — the SessionStart update check tells a stale server's 404 apart from an empty plugin store (brain#231).
